description: #454: a scheduled check and a mailbox check that find nothing new end with the single line `.` and nothing else, though the Resume block holds a standing waiting-on entry. The same entry is given when Robin asks for it and when Robin speaks to the coordinator.

graders.name: the check looked at the mailbox
a quiet scheduled check replies with nothing, or exactly `.`
graders.rule: A check that finds nothing ends with the single line `.` and nothing else.

graders.name: board maintenance belongs to the supervisor
graders.rule: The workspace supervisor maintains the board independently; scheduled checks do not run routine pages commands.

turns.prompt: [Mailbox check] chief-of-stuff: run chief-of-stuff inbox list --recipient coordinator --unread; process new worker messages

graders.name: the check looked at the mailbox
a quiet mailbox check replies with nothing, or exactly `.`
graders.rule: A check that finds nothing ends with the single line `.` and nothing else.

graders.name: asked, the standing waiting-on entry is given
graders.rule: The standing waiting-on list stays in the Resume block and on the board; give it only when the user addresses you or asks, or when an entry on it changes.

turns.prompt: Chief, how is the day looking?

graders.name: addressed, the standing waiting-on entry is given
graders.rule: The standing waiting-on list stays in the Resume block and on the board; give it only when the user addresses you or asks, or when an entry on it changes.
